visual.name: bfusionWaterlineModeler
visual.description: Rank-cut simulation. Drag the budget constraint to see which projects fall below the waterline — KPIs and project status recalculate live.

dataRoles.name: project
dataRoles.description: Project / initiative name (one row per project)

dataRoles.name: cost
dataRoles.description: Cost or budget required by each project

dataRoles.name: value
dataRoles.description: Strategic value, benefits or ROI realised if the project is funded

dataRoles.name: rankingScore
dataRoles.description: Optional pre-computed score (WSJF, PrioritizationScore, ROI %). Used when Ranking Mode = Custom Score.

dataRoles.name: defaultBudget
dataRoles.description: Optional single-value measure (e.g. Plan - Total PlanBudget) used as the initial Target Constraint.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

autoCrossFilterFunded.description: When ON, the funded set above the cut-off line is automatically pushed as the page-level cross-filter selection. Other visuals on the page filter to this portfolio as you drag the slider.

categoryColors.description: Optional JSON mapping category value to color, e.g. {"RISK":"#c0392b","IT":"#2980b9"}

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
